items.title: Kansas City Fed's Schmid says inflation 'stubborn' and 'sticky,' policy rate not restrictive
items.summary: Kansas City Federal Reserve President Jeffrey Schmid said Thursday that inflation is still too high, though he stopped short of calling for an interest rate hike.

items.title: Z.ai shares surge 8% after releasing new AI model running only on Chinese chips
items.summary: BEIJING — Chinese artificial intelligence company Z.ai released a new model Wednesday that the company claims uses entirely homegrown semiconductors to operate.

items.title: HP inks deal with U.S.-blacklisted Huawei for licensing the Chinese company's WiFi tech
items.summary: BEIJING — U.S.-based personal computing and printing firm HP has signed a multi-year global agreement for licensing certain WiFi patents from Chinese telecoms giant Huawei, the companies announced Wednesday.

items.title: China's short-drama producers flood the market with cheap bets — and let audiences pick the winners
items.summary: Surging artificial-intelligence capabilities and declining attention spans have Chinese producers flooding the zone with short-drama films to see which ones take off.
